```{r}
#| label: setup-and-load-json
#| include: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(htmltools)
  library(jsonlite)
})

# Lade Datenbank-Layer direkt aus dem autarken Deployment-Ordner (static_hub/R/)
local_r_file <- if (file.exists("R/db_connection.R")) "R/db_connection.R" else "../R_shared/db_connection.R"
source(local_r_file)

payload <- load_hub_payload()
build_ts <- format(Sys.time(), "%d.%m.%Y, %H:%M Uhr")
```

```{r}
#| label: render-editorial-hub
#| results: asis

# Hilfsfunktionen für Formatierung (inkl. Zins-Spannen-Erkennung wie "3.75-4%")
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  v <- as.numeric(x)
  if (is.na(v)) return("–")
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), v)
}

fmt_bp_delta <- function(curr, target) {
  c_val <- parse_rate_midpoint(curr)
  t_val <- parse_rate_midpoint(target)
  if (is.na(c_val) || is.na(t_val)) return(tags$span(class = "delta-badge delta-flat", "–"))
  bp <- round((t_val - c_val) * 100, 0)
  cls <- if (bp > 0) "delta-pos" else if (bp < 0) "delta-neg" else "delta-flat"
  sign_str <- if (bp > 0) "+" else ""
  tags$span(class = paste("delta-badge", cls), paste0(sign_str, bp, " Bp."))
}

stance_labels <- c(
  "-2" = "Stark untergewichtet",
  "-1" = "Untergewichtet",
  "0"  = "Neutral",
  "1"  = "Übergewichtet",
  "2"  = "Stark übergewichtet"
)

change_labels <- c(
  "-1" = "↓ Abgestuft",
  "0"  = "→ Unverändert",
  "1"  = "↑ Hochgestuft"
)

render_stance_dots <- function(s_val) {
  s <- as.integer(s_val)
  key <- as.character(s)
  lbl <- if (key %in% names(stance_labels)) stance_labels[[key]] else "Neutral"

  dots <- lapply(c(-2L, -1L, 0L, 1L, 2L), function(v) {
    is_act <- (v == s)
    bg <- if (!is_act) {
      "#CBD5E1"
    } else if (v == -2L) {
      "#B91C1C"
    } else if (v == -1L) {
      "#D97706"
    } else if (v == 0L) {
      "#475569"
    } else if (v == 1L) {
      "#0066B3"
    } else {
      "#003366"
    }
    sz <- if (is_act) "12px" else "8px"
    tags$span(style = sprintf("display:inline-block; width:%s; height:%s; border-radius:50%%; background:%s;", sz, sz, bg))
  })

  tags$div(
    style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.65rem;",
    tags$div(class = "stance-dots", dots),
    tags$span(style = "font-weight:600; font-size:0.81rem;", lbl)
  )
}

# 1. HEADER MIT TAB-LINKS

# 2. SEKTION 1: ZENTRALBANKPROGNOSEN (Spannen-Support & bedingte Kommentarspalte)
cb_has_comments <- has_any_row_comment(payload$central_banks$rows)

cb_rows <- lapply(payload$central_banks$rows, function(r) {
  tags$tr(
    tags$td(
      tags$span(class = "code-badge", r$currency),
      tags$strong(r$name),
      tags$span(style = "color:#64748B; font-size:0.79rem; margin-left:0.45rem;", r$full_name %||% "")
    ),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "font-weight:600;", format_rate_display(r$current, 2)),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "font-weight:600;", format_rate_display(r$m3, 2)),
    tags$td(class = "num", fmt_bp_delta(r$current, r$m3)),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "font-weight:700; color:#003366;", format_rate_display(r$m12, 2)),
    tags$td(class = "num", fmt_bp_delta(r$current, r$m12)),
    if (cb_has_comments) tags$td(style = "color:#334155;", r$comment %||% "")
  )
})

sec_cb_el <- tags$section(
  id = "sec-central-banks",

# 3. SEKTION 2: MAKROPROGNOSEN (Wachstum & Inflation für t-1, t, t+1 + bedingte Kommentarspalte)
base_yr <- as.integer(payload$macro$base_year %||% format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
y_prev <- base_yr - 1L
y_curr <- base_yr
y_next <- base_yr + 1L
macro_has_comments <- has_any_row_comment(payload$macro$rows)

macro_rows <- lapply(payload$macro$rows, function(r) {
  tags$tr(
    class = "macro-country-row",
    `data-code` = r$code,
    tags$td(
      tags$span(class = "code-badge", r$code),
      tags$strong(r$country)
    ),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "border-left:1px solid #E2DFD7; color:#475569;", paste0(fmt_num(r$gdp_t_minus_1, 1), " %")),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "background:#FAF9F5; font-weight:700; color:#003366;", paste0(fmt_num(r$gdp_t, 1), " %")),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "font-weight:600;", paste0(fmt_num(r$gdp_t_plus_1, 1), " %")),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "border-left:1px solid #CBD5E1; color:#475569;", paste0(fmt_num(r$cpi_t_minus_1, 1), " %")),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "background:#FAF9F5; font-weight:700; color:#003366;", paste0(fmt_num(r$cpi_t, 1), " %")),
    tags$td(class = "num", style = "font-weight:600;", paste0(fmt_num(r$cpi_t_plus_1, 1), " %")),
    if (macro_has_comments) tags$td(style = "border-left:1px solid #CBD5E1; color:#334155;", r$comment %||% "")
  )
})

sec_macro_el <- tags$section(
  id = "sec-macro",
  class = "editorial-card pub-tab-pane",
  `data-pane-key` = "macro",
  style = "display:none;",

# 4. SEKTION 3: ALLOKATIONSTABELLE MIT PROGNOSEN (+ bedingte Kommentarspalte)
alloc_has_comments <- has_any_row_comment(payload$allocation$rows)

alloc_rows <- lapply(payload$allocation$rows, function(r) {
  chg_key <- as.character(as.integer(r$change %||% 0))
  chg_lbl <- if (chg_key %in% names(change_labels)) change_labels[[chg_key]] else "→ Unverändert"
  chg_col <- if (chg_key == "1") "#0F766E" else if (chg_key == "-1") "#B45309" else "#475569"

  fc_val <- as.numeric(r$forecast_12m %||% 0)
  fc_cls <- if (fc_val > 0) "delta-pos" else if (fc_val < 0) "delta-neg" else "delta-flat"
  fc_str <- paste0(if (fc_val > 0) "+" else "", fmt_num(fc_val, 1), " %")

  tags$tr(
    tags$td(tags$strong(r$asset_class)),
    tags$td(render_stance_dots(r$stance)),
    tags$td(style = sprintf("font-weight:600; font-size:0.8rem; color:%s;", chg_col), chg_lbl),
    tags$td(class = "num", tags$span(class = paste("delta-badge", fc_cls), fc_str)),
    if (alloc_has_comments) tags$td(style = "color:#334155;", r$comment %||% "")
  )
})

# 5. FOOTER + EINGEBETTETES JSON-DOKUMENT

      tags$div("Rechtlicher Hinweis: Ausschliesslich zu Informationszwecken.")
    )
  ),
  tags$script(id = "lukb-io-hub-json", type = "application/json", HTML(raw_json_str)),
  tags$script(src = "assets/js/hub_interactivity.js")
)

htmltools::tagList(
  header_el,
  tags$main(
    class = "pub-container",
    tabs_bar_el,
    sec_cb_el,
    sec_macro_el,
    sec_alloc_el
  ),
  footer_el
)
```
